Read Our Guide to the Book of ExodusDownloadsHere are some other resources related to this video that you might find helpful.Full VideoTranscriptWord Studies4:31Euangelion / GospelGospel is one of the most common words in a Christian’s vocabulary. But what does it mean in the original languages of the Bible? In this video, we’ll discover that gospel refers to a royal announcement about Jesus, who is the crucified and risen King of the world who overcame death with his love.4:28Martus / WitnessIn the Bible, “witness” refers to both people and actions—those who see events and those who share what they’ve seen. Similar to today, this word is used in both legal settings and to describe an experience with God. But the word’s most interesting aspect is how it illuminates the story of Scripture, especially the role of the people of God.2:45What Is Passover?Watch a short video that explains the Hebrew meaning of the name for Passover and the story behind one of the Bible’s most important festivals.
